snarl.linePrev: Oh, no, no, no, you're a rock 'n' roll suicide
snarl.lineNext: As you stumble across the road
stanza: As you stumble across the road
But the day breaks instead, so you hurry home
Don't let the sun blast your shadow
Don't let the milk float ride your mind

snarl.songTitle: The Lonesome Death of Hattie Carroll
snarl.linePrev: Reacted to his deed with a shrug of his shoulders
snarl.line: And swear words and sneering, and his tongue, it was a-snarling
snarl.lineNext: And in a matter of minutes, on bail was out walking
stanza: William Zanzinger, who at twenty-four years
Owns a tobacco farm of six hundred acres
With rich wealthy parents who provide and protect him
And high office relations in the politics of Maryland
Reacted to his deed with a shrug of his shoulders
And swear words and sneering, and his tongue, it was a-snarling
And in a matter of minutes, on bail was out walking
